cohort: 53,201 term singleton deliveries between 2007 and 2014 in Tel Aviv, Israel
finding: Both GDM and LGA were independently associated with adverse delivery outcomes, including cesarean delivery, prolonged labor stages, and neonatal complications, and the presence of both had a cumulative impact.
mod_finding: Considering only women attempting vaginal delivery, large-for-gestational age (LGA) with and without gestational diabetes mellitus was associated with shoulder dystocia, prolonged second stage of labor, and jaundice.
